caseTitle.en: Flashes, a curtain and a pencil

condition.zh: 眼急症 · 視網膜剝離

title.en: An ophthalmology night in the ER

tagline.zh: 黑幕從哪邊降下來，就從對面開始找
tagline.en: Where the curtain falls, look on the opposite side

desc.zh: 散瞳、間接眼底鏡、裂隙燈、B 型超音波。急診的眼睛不會等到明天門診。
desc.en: Dilate, indirect ophthalmoscope, slit lamp, B-scan. Eyes in the ER do not wait for tomorrow's clinic.

desc.zh: 紅眼睛的四個問題、視力表、硬眼罩。你排的順序，決定誰先被看到。
desc.en: The four red-eye questions, the vision chart, the rigid shield. The order you set decides who is seen first.

role.zh: 視網膜科主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 口頭禪：「散瞳之後才叫檢查過。」間接眼底鏡永遠戴在頭上，連吃便當也是。
about.en: Catchphrase: 'It is not examined until it is dilated.' Wears the indirect ophthalmoscope on his head even at lunch.

about.zh: 每一個眼睛病人先量視力再登記，這個習慣得罪過很多人，救過更多人。
about.en: Checks vision before registration on every eye patient. The habit has annoyed many and saved more.

about.zh: 高度近視、糖尿病打胰島素。三天前右眼開始閃光、飛蚊，今天下午下方有一塊黑幕升上來。
about.en: Highly myopic, diabetic on insulin. Three days of flashes and floaters in the right eye; this afternoon a dark curtain rose from below.

about.zh: 戴隱形眼鏡二十年。左眼紅、痛、怕光兩天。所有人都覺得是隱形眼鏡的角膜炎。她的背也痛了很多年。
about.en: Twenty years in contact lenses. Two days of a red, painful, light-sensitive left eye. Everyone assumes a contact-lens keratitis. Her back has ached for years.

about.zh: 寫功課時被貓絆倒，臉撞到削好的鉛筆。右眼一直流淚，不敢張開。她說貓沒有錯。
about.en: Tripped over the cat during homework and landed face first on a sharpened pencil. Right eye streaming, will not open. She says the cat is not to blame.

about.zh: 一路用手帕壓著女兒的眼睛衝來。他做的是本能，不是對的事。
about.en: Drove in with a handkerchief pressed hard against his daughter's eye. Instinct, not the right thing.

about.zh: 開放性眼球傷的麻醉她最在意兩件事：不咳嗽、不嘔吐。
about.en: For an open globe she cares about two things: no coughing, no vomiting.

about.zh: 只在訊息裡出現。禁食的糖尿病人，她每一班都會量一次血糖。
about.en: Appears only in messages. Checks a fasting diabetic's glucose every shift, without being asked.

plain.zh: 眼前忽然有閃電、或多出很多黑點黑線，表示玻璃體在拉扯視網膜。新出現的，當天要散瞳檢查。
plain.en: Sudden lightning streaks or a shower of new dark specks mean the vitreous gel is tugging on the retina. New symptoms need a dilated examination the same day.

plain.zh: 視網膜像壁紙一樣從眼球內壁翹起來。翹起的地方看不到，病人感覺一塊黑幕。黃斑部還沒掉之前開刀，視力保得住。
plain.en: The retina lifts off the back wall of the eye like wallpaper. Where it lifts, vision goes, felt as a dark curtain. Operated on before the macula comes off, the central vision can be kept.

plain.zh: 視網膜中央負責看細節和顏色的地方。剝離有沒有波及它，決定手術急不急、視力回不回得來。
plain.en: The centre of the retina that sees detail and colour. Whether the detachment has reached it decides how urgent surgery is and how much vision returns.

plain.zh: 點藥讓瞳孔放大，才看得到視網膜周邊。沒散瞳就說視網膜正常，是沒檢查過。
plain.en: Drops widen the pupil so the edge of the retina can be seen. Calling a retina normal without dilating is not an examination.

plain.zh: 戴在頭上的燈加一片手持透鏡，看得到整個視網膜，包括最周邊的裂孔。
plain.en: A head-worn light with a hand-held lens that shows the whole retina, including tears at the far edge.

plain.zh: 眼睛的超音波。玻璃體出血看不進去時，用它看視網膜有沒有翹起來。
plain.en: Ultrasound of the eye. When bleeding in the vitreous blocks the view, it shows whether the retina has lifted.

plain.zh: 紅在角膜周圍一圈、越外越淡，表示眼睛裡面發炎；結膜炎的紅是外圍紅、角膜邊反而淡。
plain.en: Redness ringing the cornea and fading outward points to inflammation inside the eye; conjunctivitis is red at the edges and pale near the cornea.

plain.zh: 裂隙燈下，角膜和虹膜之間的水裡漂著細小的白點，像陽光下的灰塵。那是發炎細胞。
plain.en: Under the slit lamp, tiny white dots drift in the fluid between cornea and iris like dust in sunlight. Those are inflammatory cells.

plain.zh: 眼球前段的發炎：痛、怕光、睫狀充血、小瞳孔。不是細菌感染，給抗生素眼藥水沒有用，反而延誤。
plain.en: Inflammation of the front of the eye: pain, light sensitivity, ciliary flush, a small pupil. Not an infection; antibiotic drops do nothing but delay.

plain.zh: 眼球壁被穿破了。任何壓力都會把眼內容物擠出來，所以不壓、不翻眼皮、不點藥膏，罩硬眼罩送手術。
plain.en: The wall of the eye is breached. Any pressure squeezes the contents out, so no pressing, no lid eversion, no ointment: shield it and go to theatre.

plain.zh: 瞳孔被拉成水滴形，尖端指向傷口：虹膜被吸進破洞裡了。
plain.en: The pupil pulled into a teardrop whose point aims at the wound: the iris has been drawn into the hole.

plain.zh: 螢光染色後，傷口如果有房水滲出，染劑會被沖成一條亮綠色的小河。陽性就是眼球破了。
plain.en: After fluorescein, fluid leaking from a wound washes the dye into a bright green stream. Positive means the globe is open.

plain.zh: 塑膠或金屬的罩子，架在眉骨與顴骨上，不碰眼睛本身。紗布會壓到，不可以。
plain.en: A plastic or metal cup resting on the brow and cheekbone, never touching the eye itself. A gauze pad presses, and is forbidden.

plain.zh: 手術前不吃不喝。打胰島素的糖尿病人禁食時，血糖會掉，要量、要調，不是停就好。
plain.en: Nothing to eat or drink before surgery. A diabetic on insulin who fasts can go low; glucose is measured and insulin adjusted, not simply stopped.

plain.zh: 血糖太低：冒汗、發抖、恍神、說話不清，嚴重會昏迷抽搐。先量、依醫囑補糖、再量。
plain.en: Blood sugar too low: sweating, shaking, confusion, slurred speech, then coma and fits. Measure, give sugar per protocol, measure again.

text.zh: 歐主治頭上那盞燈。壓迫器一推，最周邊的裂孔無所遁形。
text.en: The lamp on Dr Ou's head. With a scleral depressor, no tear at the far edge can hide.

text.zh: 閉著眼睛也能看視網膜。探頭放在眼皮上，一條亮線連著視盤飄起來，就是剝離。
text.en: Sees the retina through closed lids. Probe on the eyelid: a bright line tethered to the disc and billowing free is a detachment.

text.zh: 短光束斜照前房，才看得到漂浮的細胞。開放性眼球傷時，只看，不碰。
text.en: A short oblique beam across the anterior chamber shows the drifting cells. With an open globe: look, never touch.

text.zh: 小米爸爸的手帕被換成它。架在骨頭上，不碰眼睛。小米在上面畫了一隻貓。
text.en: It replaced Mi's father's handkerchief. Rests on bone, touches nothing. Mi drew a cat on it.

text.zh: 筆尖斷了一小截。斷在哪裡，電腦斷層會告訴我們。
text.en: The tip broke off. Where it ended up, the CT will tell us.

text.zh: 影像在視網膜上是倒的：下方的黑幕代表上方的視網膜剝離，上方的剝離掉得快，更急。病人說的方向，先在心裡翻過來。
text.en: The image on the retina is upside down: a curtain rising from below means the upper retina has detached, and upper detachments fall fast. Flip the patient's description in your head first.

text.zh: 懷疑開放性眼球傷：不壓、不翻眼皮、不量眼壓、不點藥膏、不紗布加壓。硬眼罩、禁食、止吐、破傷風、斷層、手術室。
text.en: Suspect an open globe: no pressing, no lid eversion, no pressure measurement, no ointment, no padded dressing. Shield, nil by mouth, antiemetic, tetanus, CT, theatre.

text.zh: 禁食的糖尿病人要有血糖計畫：多久量一次、低了怎麼補、胰島素怎麼依醫囑調、通知麻醉。眼睛急，血糖也急。
text.en: A fasting diabetic needs a glucose plan: how often to check, what to give if low, how insulin is adjusted per protocol, and anaesthesia informed. The eye is urgent; so is the sugar.

text.zh: 視力有沒有掉、是真的痛還是異物感、怕不怕光、有沒有戴隱形眼鏡。四個問題答完，危險的紅眼已經被挑出來了。
text.en: Has vision dropped, is it real pain or a gritty feeling, is light painful, are contact lenses worn. Four answers, and the dangerous red eye has already been picked out.

note.zh: 歐主治的一句話，阿德的視力表
note.en: Dr Ou's one sentence, Te's vision chart

lines.zh: 今晚兩條規則。第一，散瞳之後才叫檢查過。第二，病人說黑幕在下面，你去上面找。
lines.en: Two rules tonight. One: it is not examined until it is dilated. Two: when the patient says the curtain is below, you look above.

lines.zh: 因為影像是倒的。
lines.en: Because the image is upside down.

lines.zh: 而且上面的剝離掉得快。白板上有一個閃光三天的，先看他。
lines.en: And upper detachments fall fast. There is a three-day flasher on the board; see him first.

guide.zh: 找到 B 型超音波

lines.zh: 我把 B 型超音波推到眼科床旁了。高度近視加閃光，醫師等一下會要。
lines.en: I've wheeled the B-scan to the eye bay. High myopia plus flashes; the doctor will want it.

q.zh: 點一下 B 型超音波，確認探頭與耦合劑
q.en: Tap the B-scan and check the probe and gel

post.zh: 視力我量過了：右眼只剩數手指，左眼正常。
post.en: Vision done: right eye counting fingers only, left normal.

note.zh: 高先生：上方視網膜剝離，黃斑部還在
note.en: Mr Kao: upper retinal detachment, macula still on

lines.zh: 醫師，三天前右眼開始有閃電，然後一堆黑點。今天下午下面升起一塊黑幕，像舞台布幕。
lines.en: Doctor, three days ago the right eye started flashing, then a swarm of black dots. This afternoon a curtain rose from below, like a stage curtain.

lines.zh: 正中央還看得到嗎？看我的鼻子。
lines.en: Can you still see the centre? Look at my nose.

lines.zh: 鼻子看得到，模模糊糊的。
lines.en: I can see your nose, blurry.

lines.zh: 黃斑部可能還在。下方的黑幕，剝離在上方，上面的掉得快。現在散瞳。
lines.en: The macula may still be on. A curtain from below means the detachment is above, and upper ones fall fast. Dilating now.

lines.zh: 我有糖尿病，晚餐前要打胰島素。
lines.en: I'm diabetic; I take insulin before dinner.

guide.zh: 間接眼底鏡：找視盤、找裂孔
guide.en: Indirect ophthalmoscope: disc, then the tear

lines.zh: 散開了。先找視盤定位，再往上方周邊走。
lines.en: Dilated. Find the disc to orient yourself, then sweep the upper periphery.

post.zh: 上顳側視網膜浮起來，像水裡的一片灰色波浪。十一點鐘方向一個馬蹄形裂孔。黃斑部平的。
post.en: The upper temporal retina floats like a grey wave under water. A horseshoe tear at eleven o'clock. The macula is flat.

post.zh: 黃斑部還在的上方剝離。這是今晚最急的一台刀，不是明天的。
post.en: A macula-on upper detachment. This is tonight's most urgent operation, not tomorrow's.

guide.zh: B 型超音波：玻璃體裡的霧
guide.en: B-scan: the haze in the vitreous

lines.zh: 鼻側周邊有玻璃體出血擋住。拿超音波，說你要看什麼。
lines.en: Vitreous haemorrhage blocks the nasal periphery. Take the probe and tell me what you are looking for.

question.zh: 視網膜剝離的 B 型超音波要看什麼？
question.en: What do you look for on a B-scan for retinal detachment?

answer.zh: 一條高反射的膜狀訊號是否連到視盤、眼球轉動時它怎麼飄、是局部還是全部、黃斑部有沒有翹起來，以及跟後玻璃體剝離的區別：後玻璃體剝離比較薄、不連視盤、飄得更自由。
answer.en: Whether a bright membrane-like echo is tethered to the disc, how it moves when the eye moves, whether it is partial or total, whether the macula is lifted, and how it differs from a posterior vitreous detachment, which is thinner, not attached at the disc and moves more freely.

lines.zh: 今晚開刀，從現在禁食。他打胰島素。你的計畫？
lines.en: Surgery tonight; nil by mouth from now. He is on insulin. Your plan?

q.zh: 禁食等手術的胰島素糖尿病人，怎麼做？
q.en: An insulin-treated diabetic fasting for surgery: what do you do?

options.zh: 定時量血糖、通知麻醉、依醫囑調胰島素
options.en: Scheduled glucose checks, inform anaesthesia, insulin adjusted per protocol

why.zh: 對。禁食不等於停胰島素，也不等於照常打。要有一個血糖計畫，而且麻醉要知道。
why.en: Right. Fasting is neither stopping insulin nor carrying on as usual. There must be a glucose plan, and anaesthesia must know.

why.zh: 沒有晚餐的晚餐前胰島素，一兩個小時後就是低血糖。
why.en: Pre-dinner insulin with no dinner is a hypoglycaemia an hour or two from now.

options.zh: 眼睛要緊，血糖明天再說
options.en: The eye matters; sugar can wait till tomorrow

why.zh: 低血糖的病人上不了手術台。眼睛急，血糖也急。
why.en: A hypoglycaemic patient cannot go to theatre. The eye is urgent; so is the sugar.

post.zh: 醫師，手術完我還能看報表嗎？
post.en: Doctor, will I still be able to read spreadsheets after?

post.zh: 黃斑部還在，這是最好的消息。我們今晚就是為了保住它。
post.en: Your macula is still on, and that is the best news tonight. The operation is to keep it that way.

note.zh: 陳太太：不是隱形眼鏡的錯，是虹彩炎
note.en: Mrs Chen: not the lenses after all, but iritis

lines.zh: 我戴隱形眼鏡二十年了，一定是鏡片髒了。給我抗生素眼藥水就好。
lines.en: Twenty years in contact lenses; it must be a dirty lens. Just give me antibiotic drops.

lines.zh: 先回答我四個問題，再決定藥。
lines.en: Four questions first, then we decide on drops.

post.zh: 視力掉了一點、是真的痛不是異物感、很怕光、有戴隱形眼鏡。四個全中，排在前面。
post.en: Vision down a little, real pain rather than grittiness, very light-sensitive, contact lenses. Four out of four; she goes to the front.

guide.en: Slit lamp: stain and anterior chamber

lines.zh: 螢光染色：角膜沒有破皮、沒有潰瘍。紅是繞著角膜一圈的睫狀充血。短光束斜照前房……有細胞在飄。瞳孔小。
lines.en: Fluorescein: no epithelial defect, no ulcer. The redness is a ciliary flush ringing the cornea. A short oblique beam across the anterior chamber... cells drifting. Small pupil.

lines.zh: 大家都說是隱形眼鏡。你說是什麼？
lines.en: Everyone said contact lenses. What do you say?

post.zh: 急性虹彩炎，不是角膜炎。抗生素眼藥水沒有用。陳太太，妳的背痛了多久？早上會僵硬嗎？
post.en: Acute iritis, not keratitis. Antibiotic drops would do nothing. Mrs Chen, how long has your back hurt? Is it stiff in the mornings?

post.zh: ……十幾年。早上最僵。這跟眼睛有關？
post.en: ...over ten years. Worst in the morning. That has to do with my eye?

post.zh: 有時候有關。今晚先依醫囑治療眼睛，之後請風濕科一起看。鏡片這週先休息。
post.en: Sometimes it does. Tonight the eye is treated per protocol; rheumatology sees her later. The lenses rest this week.

note.zh: 小米：開放性眼球傷，硬眼罩，不壓
note.en: Mi: an open globe, a rigid shield, no pressure

sub.zh: 9 歲女童，臉撞到鉛筆，爸爸一直壓著眼睛
sub.en: Girl of 9, face onto a pencil, father pressing on the eye

lines.zh: 9 歲女童，被貓絆倒臉撞到削好的鉛筆，右眼一直流淚不敢張。爸爸用手帕壓著衝進來。
lines.en: Girl of nine, tripped over the cat onto a sharpened pencil, right eye streaming and shut. The father ran in pressing a handkerchief on it.

lines.zh: 請爸爸現在就把手拿開，不要壓。硬眼罩先罩上，我馬上到。
lines.en: Get the father to take his hand off now; no pressure. Rigid shield on first; I'm coming.

lines.zh: 高先生等手術室、陳太太等藥、小米剛到。你現在走向誰？
lines.en: Mr Kao is waiting for theatre, Mrs Chen for drops, Mi has just arrived. Who do you walk to?

q.en: Three patients at once: in what order?

options.zh: 小米：疑開放性眼球傷，先保護
options.en: Mi: suspected open globe, protect it first

why.zh: 對。開放性眼球傷每多一次壓迫就多一次風險；高先生的手術已經排了，陳太太的藥護理師能給。
why.en: Right. Every press on an open globe is another risk; Mr Kao's surgery is already booked and the nurse can give Mrs Chen her drops.

options.zh: 高先生：視網膜剝離最急
options.en: Mr Kao: the detachment is most urgent

why.zh: 他的刀已經排了，等的是手術室不是你。小米等的是你。
why.en: His operation is booked; he is waiting for theatre, not for you. Mi is waiting for you.

why.zh: 急診沒有掛號順序，只有危險順序。
why.en: The ER has no registration order, only an order of danger.

guide.en: Look, don't touch: pupil and Seidel

lines.zh: 貓咪沒有錯。是我自己跌倒的。
lines.en: The cat didn't do anything wrong. I fell by myself.

lines.zh: 我知道，貓咪沒有錯。小米，我只看不碰，妳自己慢慢張開一點點就好。
lines.en: I know; the cat did nothing wrong. Mi, I'm only looking, not touching. Open just a little by yourself.

lines.zh: 裂隙燈下：瞳孔被拉成淚滴狀，尖端指向角膜下方的小傷口。前房淺。螢光染色一滴上去，一條亮綠色的小河。
lines.en: Under the slit lamp: the pupil drawn into a teardrop pointing at a small wound in the lower cornea. The chamber is shallow. One drop of fluorescein, and a bright green stream.

lines.zh: 判讀。
lines.en: Interpret.

lines.zh: 我壓著是不是壓壞了？
lines.en: Did I make it worse by pressing?

lines.zh: 從現在起不壓就好。接下來每一步我都說給您聽。
lines.en: From now on, no pressing, and that is enough. I'll tell you every step from here.

q.zh: 疑開放性眼球傷的處置順序
q.en: Order of management for a suspected open globe

steps.zh: 停止檢查，不壓、不翻眼皮
steps.en: Stop examining: no pressure, no lid eversion
Nil by mouth; antiemetic and analgesia per protocol

steps.zh: 破傷風與抗生素依醫囑

post.zh: 我是麻醉科馮醫師。小米幾點吃的晚餐？不能咳、不能吐，誘導我會特別小心。
post.en: Dr Feng, anaesthesia. When did Mi last eat? No coughing, no vomiting; I'll be careful with the induction.

lines.zh: 為什麼是電腦斷層，不是磁振造影？片子上要找什麼？
lines.en: Why CT and not MRI? And what are you looking for?

question.zh: 開放性眼球傷為何用 CT？要看什麼？
question.en: Why CT for an open globe, and what do you look for?

answer.zh: 可能有金屬異物時磁振造影會把它拉動，所以用電腦斷層。要看眼內或眼眶內異物（鉛筆芯與木頭可能不明顯）、眼球輪廓是否變形塌陷、玻璃體內有沒有空氣、水晶體位置、眼眶骨折與視神經。
answer.en: A possible metal fragment would move in an MRI, so CT is used. Look for an intraocular or orbital foreign body (pencil lead and wood can be subtle), a distorted or collapsed globe contour, air in the vitreous, the position of the lens, orbital fractures and the optic nerve.

post.zh: 斷層：眼球輪廓略扁，前房淺，沒有看到異物。斷掉的筆尖在她的作業本上找到了。
post.en: CT: the globe slightly flattened, a shallow chamber, no foreign body seen. The broken pencil tip turned up in her homework book.

note.zh: 高先生低血糖：眼睛急，血糖也急
note.en: Mr Kao hypoglycaemic: the eye is urgent, so is the sugar

lines.zh: 醫師，高先生一直冒汗、手抖，剛剛叫他名字反應慢。
lines.en: Doctor, Mr Kao is sweating and shaking, and he was slow to answer his name just now.

lines.zh: 禁食的糖尿病人，恍神、冒汗、發抖。
lines.en: A fasting diabetic, confused, sweating, shaking.

options.zh: 立刻量血糖、依醫囑補糖、復測、通知麻醉
options.en: Check glucose now, give sugar per protocol, recheck, tell anaesthesia

why.zh: 對。先量再補，補完再量。他禁食，所以依醫囑從靜脈給。手術時間要跟麻醉重新確認。
why.en: Right. Measure, treat, measure again. He is fasting, so it goes intravenously per protocol. Confirm the theatre time with anaesthesia again.

why.zh: 他禁食等開刀。能吞的話口服很好，但現在要走靜脈依醫囑，並通知麻醉。
why.en: He is fasting for theatre. Oral sugar is fine when allowed; now it goes intravenously per protocol, and anaesthesia is told.

options.en: He's anxious; tell him to breathe

why.zh: 冒汗、發抖、恍神的禁食糖尿病人，先當低血糖，量了才知道。
why.en: A sweating, shaking, confused fasting diabetic is hypoglycaemic until a glucose says otherwise.

post.zh: 血糖很低。依醫囑補糖後，高先生問現在幾點、他的手術還開不開。
post.en: Glucose very low. After sugar per protocol, Mr Kao asks what time it is and whether his operation is still on.

guide.en: Dr Ou stands at the foot of the bed

lines.zh: 晚餐前那一針，你讓他照常打了。晚餐呢？
lines.en: You let him have the pre-dinner dose. And dinner?

lines.zh: ……禁食。
lines.en: ...nil by mouth.

lines.zh: 眼睛急的時候，最容易忘記病人還有身體。記住今晚。
lines.en: When the eye is urgent it is easiest to forget the patient has a body. Remember tonight.

note.zh: 小米的眼球修補：時間暫停

guide.zh: 開放性眼球傷修補的時間暫停

lines.zh: 小米先開，高先生接著。時間暫停你來帶：病人、右眼、開放性眼球傷修補、破傷風與抗生素已給、麻醉誘導平順。
lines.en: Mi first, Mr Kao straight after. You lead the time-out: patient, right eye, open-globe repair, tetanus and antibiotics given, induction smooth.

lines.zh: 沒有咳嗽，沒有嘔吐。她睡著前問貓咪有沒有吃晚餐。
lines.en: No cough, no vomiting. She asked whether the cat had had its dinner before she went under.

lines.zh: 醫師……她會不會看不到？
lines.en: Doctor... will she lose her sight?

lines.zh: 傷口小、斷層沒有異物、水晶體看起來還好。今晚先把眼球關起來，視力要等幾週才知道。我不會給您一個今晚給不了的答案。
lines.en: The wound is small, the CT shows no foreign body, the lens looks intact. Tonight we close the eye; vision takes weeks to declare itself. I won't give you an answer tonight that I cannot give.

lines.zh: ……謝謝你沒有騙我。
lines.en: ...thank you for not lying to me.

note.zh: 一塊黑幕、一圈充血、一支鉛筆、一次低血糖
note.en: A curtain, a flush, a pencil and one low sugar

lines.zh: 今晚三件事。高先生的黑幕在下面，你往上找，找到了。
lines.en: Three things tonight. Mr Kao's curtain was below; you looked above and found it.

lines.zh: 陳太太，所有人都說隱形眼鏡，你看了前房。小米，你第一句話是叫爸爸把手拿開。
lines.en: Mrs Chen: everyone said contact lenses, and you looked at the anterior chamber. Mi: your first words were to get the father's hand off.

lines.zh: 高先生的血糖呢？
lines.en: And Mr Kao's sugar?

lines.zh: 那是第四件，寫在你自己的本子上。高先生的視網膜已經貼回去了，黃斑部沒掉。
lines.en: That is the fourth; write it in your own notebook. Mr Kao's retina is back on, and the macula never came off.

sub.zh: 「高先生血糖穩、趴姿擺好了。小米睡了，眼罩上畫了一隻貓。」
sub.en: 'Mr Kao: glucose steady, positioned face down. Mi asleep; there is a cat drawn on her shield.'

lines.zh: 一塊黑幕、一圈睫狀充血、一支鉛筆、一次低血糖。貓咪沒有錯。
lines.en: A curtain, a ciliary flush, a pencil and one low sugar. The cat did nothing wrong.

lines.zh: 值班未完。間接眼底鏡放回充電座，歐主治的頭上第一次沒有燈。
lines.en: The night goes on. The indirect ophthalmoscope sits back in its charger; for the first time tonight there is no lamp on Dr Ou's head.

sub.en: It is not examined until it is dilated
